40680.synonym: upanibha, upama, disa, nibha, patirūpaka, saṅkāsa, sadisa, sannibha, sappaṭibhāga, sarikkhaka, sarūpa

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇapaṭibhāgāni

40681.commentary: (MNa) sukhāya pan'āyye'tiādim'āha. tassa vissajjane yasmā sukhassa dukkhaṃ, dukkhassa ca sukhaṃ paccanīkaṃ, tasmā dvīsu vedanāsu visabhāgapaṭibhāgo kathito.

examples.text: dukkhāya pann'āyye, vedanāya kiṃ paṭibhāgo'ti? dukkhāya kho, āvuso visākha, vedanāya sukhā vedanā paṭibhāgo'ti. adukkham'asukhāya pan'āyye, vedanāya kiṃ paṭibhāgo'ti? adukkham'asukhāya kho, āvuso visākha, vedanāya avijjā paṭibhāgo'ti.

40684.meaning2: ready wit; promptitude; readiness of speech; intelligence

examples.text: āyudo balado dhīro, vaṇṇado paṭibhāṇado, sukhassa dātā medhāvī, sukhaṃ so adhigacchati.
āyuṃ datvā balaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, sukhañ'ca paṭibhāṇakaṃ, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.
āyudo balado dhīro, vaṇṇado paṭibhāṇado, sukhassa dātā medhāvī, sukhaṃ so adhigacchati.
evaṃ pabbajito c'āhaṃ, na cirena bahussuto, ahosiṃ dhammakathiko, vicittapaṭibhāṇavā.

40689.meaning1: comes to mind; occurs (to); inspires (someone to)
40689.meaning2: comes into one's mind, is evident
40689.commentary: (MNa) paṭibhāti maṃ bhagavā'ti bhagavā mayhaṃ ekaṃ kāraṇaṃ upaṭṭhāti paññāyati.

examples.text: ko pana, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo yen'ekadā dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatā'pi mantā paṭibhanti, pag'eva sajjhāyakatā'ti?
bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata, bhante, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī'ti.

40690.meaning2: ready wit, promptitude, readiness of speech

examples.text: sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu! bhaddako kho te, bhikkhu, ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā
purimen'ev'āhaṃ, bhante, opammena bhagavato attamano abhiraddho. api c'āhaṃ imāni bhagavato vicitrāni pañhapaṭibhānāni sotu'kāmo, ev'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, byākataṃ kho, āvuso, amhehi sabbeh'eva yathāsakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ.
evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca, byākataṃ kho, āvuso revata, āyasmatā ānandena yathāsakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ.

40692.commentary: (ANa) yuttappaṭibhāno no muttappaṭibhāno'ti pañhaṃ kathento yuttam'eva katheti, sīghaṃ pana na katheti, saṇikam'eva kathetī'ti attho. iminā nayena sabbapadāni veditabbāni.

examples.text: yuttappaṭibhāno, no muttappaṭibhāno, muttappaṭibhāno, no yuttappaṭibhāno, yuttappaṭibhāno ca muttappaṭibhāno ca, n'eva yuttappaṭibhāno na muttappaṭibhāno
evaṃ vutte, ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
imehi kho, puṇṇiya, dasahi dhammehi samannāgatā ek'antapaṭibhānā tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā hotī'ti.
āyuṃ datvā balaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, sukhañ'ca paṭibhānakaṃ, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.
āyuṃ datvā balaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, sukhañ'ca paṭibhānakaṃ, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.

40696.commentary: (ANa) yo taṅ'khaṇaññ'eva vaṅg'īsatthero viya attano paṭibhānena karoti, ayaṃ paṭibhānakavi nāmā'ti.

examples.text: katame cattāro? cintākavi, sutakavi, atthakavi, paṭibhānakavi, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro kavī'ti.

40697.meaning1: peak of understanding; summit of intelligence; place name

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate. atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, āyāma, bhikkhave, yena paṭibhānakūṭo ten'upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā'ti.

40698.commentary: (VINa) paṭibhānacittan'ti attano paṭibhānena katacittaṃ, so kira cīvaraṃ rajitvā tassa majjhe nānāvaṇṇehi vippakatamethunaṃ itthipurisarūpam'akāsi.

examples.text: āyudo balado dhīro, vaṇṇado paṭibhānado, sukhassa dātā medhāvī, sukhaṃ so adhigacchati.
